meanings.usage: 指参与绑架他人的人，通常为了索要赎金
强调数量或程度之大，常用于正式语境
形容拥有大量财富的人，是rich的正式表达
形容事物有条理、有规则，也可指人守秩序
disappear的名词形式，指某人或某物不见的情况
指不透露身份或姓名的，常用于信件、捐款等
绑架案中要求支付的金钱，作为释放人质的条件
正式用语，指给出明确的指示或命令
指从银行账户中取出资金，也可用作收回承诺等
准时地，强调时间的精确性，是punctual的副词形式
语气比surprise更强，表示极度惊讶
指用于制作盒子等的厚纸材料
英式英语，指同一层楼的公寓套房
双重含义：1.表示亲爱的、珍贵的 2.表示价格高的；本课利用这双关
指与他人共同使用或拥有某物

examples.en: They recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Ramsay's cat.
examples.zh: 他们最近对拉姆齐夫人的猫非常感兴趣。

phrases.usage: 安全；处于可信赖的人手中

examples.en: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands.
examples.zh: 写信人称拉斯塔斯很安全。

examples.en: She changed her mind and decided to pay the ransom.
examples.zh: 她改变了主意，决定支付赎金。

examples.en: Mrs. Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
examples.zh: 拉姆齐夫人确信绑匪会遵守诺言。

examples.en: She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.
She withdrew money and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
examples.zh: 她取了钱并按照绑匪的指示行事。
拉斯塔斯过着有规律的生活。

phrases.usage: 不止一种方式；多方面地

examples.en: Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.zh: 考虑到她付出的金额，拉斯塔斯多方面都很珍贵！

phrases.usage: 对某人来说很珍贵/亲爱的

examples.en: Rastus was very dear to her.
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。

examples.en: The letter had made that quite clear.
examples.zh: 信里已经把这一点说得清清楚楚。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作，常与when、while等连用 用于描述过去正在发生的动作背景，或与一般过去时连用表示过去某事发生时有另一动作在进行

examples.en: One evening, however, he failed to arrive.
examples.zh: 然而，有一天晚上，他没有按时回家。

grammar.title: 条件状语从句 (Conditional Clause)
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 过去式, 主语 + would/could + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 由if引导的条件句，表达假设的情况及其可能的结果 用于谈论不太可能发生的假设情况，或与过去事实相反的虚拟语气

examples.en: She decided to go to the police, but fearing that she would never see Rastus again, she changed her mind.
examples.zh: 她本想去报警，但又担心再也见不到拉斯塔斯了，于是改变了主意。

grammar.title: 双关语 (Pun)
grammar.structure: 同一个词在不同语境下有不同含义
grammar.definition: 利用词语的多义性或同音异义词创造幽默效果的修辞手法 用于创造幽默效果，本课中'dear'既表示'亲爱的'又表示'昂贵的'，形成文字游戏

examples.en: Rastus was very dear to her. Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!
examples.zh: 拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。考虑到她付出的金额，他多方面都很值钱！

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has shared + 名词 + with + 某人 + for + 时间段

original.en: Mrs. Eleanor Ramsay has shared a flat with her cat for a great many years.
original.zh: 埃莱娜·拉姆齐夫人和她的猫拉斯塔斯已经共同居住在一套公寓里很多年了。

imitations.en: He has shared an office with his brother for five years.
imitations.zh: 他和哥哥已经共用一间办公室五年了。

imitations.en: Mary has shared a room with her sister since childhood.
imitations.zh: 玛丽从小就和妹妹同住一个房间。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was + 形容词, though + 主语 + 动词

original.en: He looked very well, though he was rather thirsty.
original.zh: 他看起来很健康，虽然相当口渴。

imitations.en: She seemed happy, though she was actually quite tired.
imitations.zh: 她看起来很开心，虽然实际上很累。

imitations.en: The book was interesting, though it was a bit long.
imitations.zh: 这本书很有趣，虽然有点长。

original.en: Sure enough, Rastus arrived punctually at seven o'clock that evening.
original.zh: 果然，拉斯塔斯那天晚上准时七点回来了。

imitations.en: The train arrived exactly at nine o'clock as expected.
imitations.zh: 火车正如预期的那样准时九点到达。

imitations.en: He came right on time for the meeting.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + explained that + 从句

original.en: She explained that Rastus was very dear to her.
original.zh: 她解释说拉斯塔斯对她来说非常珍贵。

imitations.en: He explained that the project would take another month.
imitations.zh: 他解释这个项目还需要一个月。

imitations.en: The teacher explained that the exam would be next Friday.
imitations.zh: 老师解释说考试将在下周五进行。

translation:
绑架者很少对动物感兴趣。最近，绑架者却盯上了埃莉诺.拉姆齐太太的猫。埃莉诺.拉姆齐太太是一个非常富有的老妇人，多年来，一直同她养的猫拉斯一起住在一所公寓里。拉斯特斯生活很有规律，傍晚常常出去溜达一会儿，并且总是在7点钟以前回来。可是，有一天晚上，它出去后再也没回来。拉姆齐太太急坏了，四处寻找，但没有找着。
拉斯特斯失踪3天后，拉姆齐太太收到一封匿名信。写信人声称拉斯特斯安然无恙，只要拉姆齐太太愿意支付1,000 英镑赎金，可以立即将猫送还。他让拉姆齐太太把钱放在一个纸盒里，然后将纸盒放在门口。一开始拉姆齐太太打算报告警察，但又害怕再也见不到拉斯特斯——这点，信上说得十分明白——于是便改变了主意。她从银行取出1,000 英镑，并照绑架者的要求做了。第二天早晨，放钱的盒子不见了。但拉姆齐太太确信绑架者是会履行诺言的。果然，当天晚上7点正，拉斯特斯准时回来了。它看上去一切正常，只是口渴得很，喝了半瓶牛奶。拉姆齐太太把她所做的事告诉了警察，警察听后大为吃惊。拉姆齐太太解释说她心疼她的猫拉斯特斯。想到她所花的那笔钱，她的心疼就具有双重意义了。

lines.en: Kidnappers are rarely interested in animals, but they recently took considerable interest in Mrs.
Eleanor Ramsay's cat.
Mrs.
Eleanor Ramsay, a very wealthy old lady, has shared a flat with her cat, Rastus, for a great many years.
Rastus leads an orderly life.
He usually takes a short walk in the evenings and is always home by seven o'clock.
One evening, however, he failed to arrive.
Mrs.
Ramsay got very worried.
She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.
There days after Rastus' disappearance , Mrs.
Ramsay received an anonymous letter.
The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs.
Ramsay paid a ransom of $1,000.
Mrs.
Ramsay was instructed to place the money in a cardboard box and to leave it outside her door.
At first she decided to go to the police, but fearing that she would never see Rastus again -- the letter had made that quite clear -- she changed her mind.
She withdrew $1000 from her bank and followed the kidnapper 's instructions.
The next morning, the box had disappeared but Mrs.
Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.
Sure enough, Rastus arrived punctually at seven o'clock that evening.
He looked very well though he was rather thirsty, for he drank half a bottle of milk.
The police were astounded when Mrs.
Ramsay told them what she had done.
She explained that Rastus was very dear to her.
Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one!

lead.summary: 绑架者很少对动物感兴趣。最近，绑架者却盯上了埃莉诺.拉姆齐太太的猫。语法聚焦：on what conditions  B正确。
lead.tips: 语法重点：on what conditions  B正确。重点词汇：dear、kidnapper、considerable 等，结合课文例句记忆。练法：先盲听跟读，再对照参考译文理解，最后尝试复述课文。
lead.question: Why was Rastus 'very dear' in more ways than one?
